adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a type mismatch bug. Looking at the diff, `refreshOAuthTokens` in packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts returns either a `Response` object (from fetch) or the result of `refreshFunction()`. In the HubSpot case (packages/app-store/hubspot/lib/CalendarService.ts lines 176-191), the code wraps the hubspot SDK call in `refreshOAuthTokens`, but when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` is true, it returns a native `fetch` Response instead of the HubspotToken. The variable `hubspotRefreshToken` is typed as `HubspotToken` but would actually be a `Response` object in sync mode, causing `hubspotRefreshToken.expiresIn` and `hubspotRefreshToken.accessToken` to be undefined. This would result in invalid credential data being stored.
